searchText: Hey all, just ran the difficulty bomb numbers. Even with the lower difficulty It will show up between 1 - 2 months from now. So the first week of august looks comfy It would start showing around the third week of august On block 13_100_000 So this could be the first time we’re _ahead_ of schedule 😮? Love it! https://etherscan.io/block/countdown/13100000 Is etherscan's ETA wrong then? https://etherscan.io/block/countdown/12965000 "Thu Aug 05 2021 00:43:57 GMT+0200 (Central European Summer Time)" It very much depends on the average block time between now and then I guess? 13.0 - 13.1 seconds will give you 11 - 17h UTC on August 4th, but it seems the average block time has been a bit higher Yeah it’s very hard to predict the exact time, and I’ve found etherscan‘s estimate to change by several hours as we get closer to the forks. Merged ✅ Block `12965000` confirmed for mainnet 🇬🇧 We'll double-check on our PR to add the blocknumber. I'll do it this evening unless someone beats me to it <@!425269142615097345> already double-checked, but triple-checking is even better 🙂 Hi Tim, is there going to be an official announcement for this? Especially regarding the doubling of the gas limit for miners (which weren't very clear in the testnets announcement on how important it is). I would like to help share this message in the community as well. Yes, expect a blog post on blog.ethereum.org next week, once all the clients have a mainnet-compatible release out I see that Geth has added the `miner_setGasLimit` API for miners to change the gas limit without having to shut down their node. Have any other clients implemented such a change? If so, will link them in the blog post. Actually, it seems like most teams have this already. <@&595684226221735986>, `parity_setGasCeilTarget` can you confirm is that call? <@&836981603216654336> is it `miner_changeTargetGasLimit`? <@&652918665943056397> + <@&688101493978562687> don't seem to have anything, but AIUI, can't mine on mainnet, right? yes for besu it's miner_changeTargetGasLimit true for OE also... for geth do miners need to double `miner.gastarget` too or only `miner.gaslimit`? ✅ ✅ ✅ `0xb715077d` True for Nethermind 😉 cross-posting from 1559-dev: <@!543900561460822016> has an open issue about different clients having different behavior re: `effectiveGasPrice` in pre-London blocks: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/749160974506000444/862391437681360927 It would be good for clients to have the same behavior here 🙂 gastarget will be pre-london gaslimit , gastlimit will be double
